proposal.inferred_root_cause: PSP degradation on the upi path for upi:ybl at 32% success over 96 attempts
proposal.reasoning_trace: upi:ybl has dropped to 32% success over 96 attempts against a 90% portfolio baseline, and the only open notice names upi:paytm, a different issuer on the same method. Partial success means the issuer is reachable, so the losses are concentrated in the gateway hop the code points at. The open notice on upi:paytm is a different issuer and explains nothing here. This is a recurring debit, so RBI's 24-hour cooling window is longer than any backoff this class would justify: the timing is set by regulation, not by the hazard estimate, and the pre-debit notice has to go out before the retry does.
